name: Linger Lodge RV Park
note: Family-run park beside the Linger Lodge restaurant on the Braden River, rebuilt with new concrete pads. RVs must be 10 years old or newer unless management approves, and arrivals are only 2-5 pm (Sun noon-2). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site lingerlodge.com (sites/rates/rules pages read 2026-10-21): full-hookup Lodge/Jungle/River/Tiki lots sold daily, weekly and monthly, welcomes Class A/B/C, trailers and 5th wheels 10 yrs or newer, published daily rates; Campspot engine (park 1804) read 2026-10-21 sells a single night Tue 10/27/2026 to 2 adults with 122 sites open by the night across 5 types fitting 26-65 ft (Lodge Lot to 33 ft), no application -> real transient RV park, not a home community; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Campspot per-site map (read 2026-10-21) puts the 38 'River Lot' sites on the outer ring of the south loop and the NE loop, both inside bends of the Braden River. Esri World Imagery read 2026-10-21 (900 m, 220 m, 140 m and 110 m frames, all rendered): on the south loop's east arc (~27.4120,-82.4475) the outer pads end ~15-20 m from the water across an open, unused grass bank with only scattered small trees; USGS 3DEP lidar there falls gently from 2.1 m at the pad to 0.5 m at the water over ~14 m (no bluff, no dam). The NE loop's outer River Lots are NOT on the water: ~20-25 m back behind a continuous shrub/tree belt and a sandy ridge (lidar 3.0 m pad, 4.7 m ridge, 0.5 m river) -> riverfront on the south-loop River Lots only
fees_source: https://www.lingerlodge.com/rates read 2026-10-21: cheapest type Lodge Lot (fits to 33 ft per Campspot) $60/night Apr 1-Dec 31 2026, $85/night Nov 1 2025-Mar 31 2026 and Jan 1-Mar 31 2027, incl. electric/water/sewer/wifi. Campspot (lingerlodgervpark) read 2026-10-21, 2 adults: Tue 10/27/2026 1 night Lodge Lot $64.00 total, 3 nights $184.00 total (= 3 x $60 + a $4 per-stay fee, not per night); Tue 2/9/2027 Lodge Lot listed $89 avg (sold out that date), Jungle Lot $124; before tax
flags: Peak winter base is $85/night (Lodge Lot, Nov-Mar); Apr-Dec $60. Included only because the price gate is lifted.

Waterfront is a close call: riverfront rests on the south loop's east-arc River Lots (open grass bank ~15-20 m to the river in legible imagery); the operator's own River Lots photo shows a treeline behind the pads, and the NE-loop River Lots sit behind a shrub belt. If AWH reads it stricter, riverview/not waterfront.
A $4 per-stay fee appears in Campspot quotes (likely the booking fee); not stored.
A 2016 Campendium review mentions permanent residents; that predates the rebuild, and the current engine sells 122 sites by the night on an October Tuesday.
